npcs.name: CH 3-6 N Sailor Working On SS Anne
npcs.meet_text: I've been working all day I'm absolutely shattered.
npcs.repeat_text: Most passengers went back to the ship earlier but I saw some shady characters actually getting off.

npcs.name: CH 3-6 N Sailor 2 Pier 1
npcs.meet_text: Oh boy I am pooped. Some guys dressed in black headed past this way earlier as if they were going to go to the forest.
npcs.repeat_text: The forest is still closed until morning though so not sure where they were going.

npcs.name: CH 3-6 N Sailor Working On Dock
npcs.meet_text: I can't wait for the SS Anne to leave now, I've never been busier.
npcs.repeat_text: Us sailors are hard workers as it is but this is too much for us!

npcs.name: CH 3-6 N Sabrina
npcs.meet_text: Your town is much quieter than Saffron. I'm Sabrina, I knew you would be coming. You'll be challenging me soon I can see that, but this might help you win against me.
npcs.repeat_text: Good luck with the Gym Hero Challenge. I know you're going to do well.

npcs.name: CH 3-6 N Koga
npcs.meet_text: Out here in the cover of darkness too? I'm Koga. I was once the Gym Leader of Fuschia and then made it as an Indigo League Elite 4 member. I've been asked here to help in the Gym Hero challenge. As you're out here at this hour you might appreciate this.
npcs.repeat_text: I won't take it easy on you if you come to take the challenge so be prepared.

npcs.name: CH 3-6 N Giovanni
npcs.meet_text: You shouldn't be out here so late, there's not always nice people wandering around at this hour. I promised not to cause trouble while I'm here but why not a little mischief? As proof I'm not evil, take this.
npcs.repeat_text: I am Giovanni. I was once the leader of Team Rocket and the gym leader in Viridian. Now I'm not formally either, but Team Rocket will always live on.

opponents.name: Birdspotter Gregg
opponents.meet_text: My friend got hungry so decided to head back, but I'm interested to see what birds are out at night.
opponents.repeat_text: This really is a great spot for birds and cards!
opponents.first_win_text: Do you hate birds or something?.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Well at least I can watch the birds from around here.
opponents.loss_text: Looking after birds really isn't easy!

opponents.name: Guitarist Jonesy
opponents.meet_text: We're in a band and we're currently touring. We're just passing through to our next gig so having a quick jam here.
opponents.first_win_text: Damn I snapped a string while we were jamming.
opponents.rematch_win_text: You should come to one of our gigs!

opponents.name: Guitarist Howard
opponents.meet_text: We're the Toxtricity Rockers, we're a duo that's pretty big in Johto.
opponents.repeat_text: You here to hear a song or a rematch?
opponents.loss_text: If it's any consolation I'll give you a discount on our album.

opponents.name: Garden Manager Louis
opponents.meet_text: I might be the garden manager but I do know how to have fun.
opponents.repeat_text: Look at how great the gardens look.
opponents.first_win_text: Even with all this sun I couldn't win.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Ever fancied being a gardener yourself?

opponents.name: Sailor Bob
opponents.meet_text: Most of the passengers have returned on board for the night now so it's quiet again as usual.
opponents.repeat_text: There's still time before the morning shift.
opponents.first_win_text: I should at least pretend to do some work on the dock.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I won't have a lot of time to during the day now the ship has docked.
opponents.loss_text: All this spare time has given me a chance to practice.

opponents.name: Hiker Ben
opponents.meet_text: Well that's incredibly disappointing. I was hoping to have a trek through the forest but they've told me it's shut so I have nowhere to go now.
opponents.repeat_text: The forest has to be open soon surely.
opponents.first_win_text: Well that's another disappointment to my day.
opponents.loss_text: At least that's given me a nice little boost after the bad news.

opponents.name: Engineer Brad
opponents.meet_text: Hey, I've been working hard all day so I'm ready to play
opponents.repeat_text: It's rare I have to work at night so I'm free for another match.
opponents.first_win_text: I simply cannot fix that at all.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I'm going to weld my cards at this rate.
opponents.loss_text: You just need to work harder

opponents.name: Bad Dude Wayne
opponents.meet_text: I caught these bad looking dudes heading to the forest and they gave me some interesting cards and went on their way.
opponents.first_win_text: You even seen a Dark Pokemon before?
opponents.rematch_win_text: I need some more of these Dark cards.

opponents.name: Rocket Grunt Damien
opponents.meet_text: I'm here on bosses orders but we're not starting until tomorrow so you'll be good practice.
opponents.repeat_text: I'm not really a bad guy but I can't let people know that.
opponents.first_win_text: Oh no, don't tell the boss.
opponents.loss_text: Ha ha, you didn't put up much of a fight.

opponents.name: Rocket Grunt Penny
opponents.meet_text: Team Rocket used to be the most feared group in the world. Maybe we will be again.
opponents.repeat_text: Have you ever heard of us before?
opponents.first_win_text: Weren't you even a little bit scared?
opponents.rematch_win_text: I really gotta act more scary.
opponents.loss_text: If you didn't already you should definitely fear us now.
